small_ui.source:
You have found the back room.

Blackjack, hold'em and a single-zero wheel. They take the same roubles you would spend on ammunition, and they take them for good.

A stake leaves your stash the moment you commit it. Winnings are paid straight back in. There is no chip balance and nothing to cash out.

The house keeps its edge whatever you do. Play with what you could lose in a raid.

무엇을 하든 하우스의 우위는 유지됩니다. 레이드에서 잃어도 감당할 수 있는 만큼만 플레이하세요.

small_ui.source:
The casino was taken down for a day, and you may have wondered where it went.

Sorry for the wait. Have {amount} roubles on the house.

It is in your stash already. Spend it at whichever table you like.

카지노가 하루 동안 내려가 있어서 어디로 갔는지 궁금하셨을 겁니다.

기다리게 해서 죄송합니다. 카지노에서 {amount}루블을 드립니다.
